DATA_LIST_FILE="${MODE}_files.txt"

OUTPUT_DIR="${HOME}/scratch/ImageNet/tf_records/${MODE}"

mkdir -p ${HOME}/scratch/ImageNet/tf_records

echo "done BBox" >>  $LOG_DIR/\${FLUX_JOB_NAME}_index_\${index}_of_${NUM_DIV}_jobid_\${FLUX_JOB_ID}.err
echo "done BBox" >>  $LOG_DIR/\${FLUX_JOB_NAME}_index_\${index}_of_${NUM_DIV}_jobid_\${FLUX_JOB_ID}.out

EOF

chmod u=rwx $BB_RUN_SCRIPT

echo "Doing flux run -n 16 -N 1 -- $BB_RUN_SCRIPT "
flux run -n 16 -N 1 -- $BB_RUN_SCRIPT
